BFR105-PW-01 — Pact Automaton Sentinel / Pressure Wave.
PRINTED: one target; save DC15; 3d8 force on failure; an unspecified control effect. Printed save ability, range, control definition and success effect are missing.
NEW: one perceived, legally targetable creature within30ft of a declared emitter point on the Sentinel's actual body, with an unobstructed line to an actual interior target point. Record emitter and target-point positions at release. The emitter cannot be moved outside the body to gain range. Range is Euclidean for this expressly scoped three-dimensional action; this is not a global grid rewrite.
This is a magical nonspell native force action, not a learned spell or class resource. It requires one real Action, or one of the two selections in this Sentinel's printed Multiattack; that limited substitution is explicit NEW authorship. Each selected Wave has its own save/dice/root. No RP, V/S/F, ammunition, concentration or recharge is added. Current source-qualified suppression can prevent its magical output; ordinary spell-only Counterspell does not become permission to counter this nonspell.
After actual interruptions and target revalidation, make one STR save DC15. Success prevents both damage and push; do not roll damage and do not apply half damage. Failure rolls3d8 force once. After that damage's actual life/concentration consequences, a still-eligible extant creature recipient is pushed up to10ft in the fixed direction from the discharge emitter through the declared target point. Normalize that direction; zero-length origin-to-target is illegal at declaration. Sweep the recipient's whole body along it, stopping at the first placement obstruction. An actual push-reduction effect such as already-paid Brace applies within its own scope. No size exemption or extra save is invented.
The push is instantaneous: no Prone, Stunned, restraint, persistent zone or repeated tick is added. Completed damage/push remains after source suppression, death or later removal; those events before discharge can prevent that pending discharge. It does not move a now-dead body as a new creature effect.
Containment Pulse stays separate and unchanged: area, STR DC15,5d6 force, half on success, Recharge5–6 and its printed charge-up. Its unspecified area, formation mechanics and broader recharge/Multiattack questions remain for their own parts. It is not a Pressure Wave variant and is not granted as a slot in this Part01's two-selection substitution.
Reason/tradeoff: a resisted single-target10ft displacement supplies meaningful disruption without importing an area blast, Prone or another game's profile. One-third of the printed damage has not been removed: success-zero follows the printed 'succeed ... or take' conditional. All missing parameters are NEW proposals.
Reconciliation selection BFR105-D02: this one action overrides the minimum-body-separation range sentence of Return02 B02-GEOMETRY. At declaration choose an actual emitter location attached to the acting body's anatomy (surface or interior, never a proxy projected outside it) and one actual interior witness in the chosen recipient. Record their body-local coordinates and resulting world segment; check positive Euclidean segment length at most30ft and unobstructed line of effect along that SAME segment, plus actual perception. At this outcome's resolution update those attached points from their actual bodies and revalidate them; a vanished, obstructed, out-of-range or no-longer-interior witness fails this committed outcome without a replacement target, relocated emitter or refund. At the resolved discharge freeze that segment for the instantaneous push vector. Equality at30ft is legal only when that actual interior witness is at30ft; an exterior face at30ft with every interior point farther away does not qualify. The selected procedure does not change other melee/ranged/area geometry. It changes no trait-imposed displacement prevention. The 10ft/no-Prone choice is retained from Part01; the 5ft-plus-Prone Return02 choice is superseded for this action only. Existing independently caused Prone is not removed.
Type-language clarification: the historical Part01 word 'living' is not selected as an added type restriction. The printed one-target action has no living-only gate; an extant eligible nonliving creature is not excluded merely by type. Actual destruction/removal still ends its creature-target eligibility. This does not turn corpse remains into a creature.

BFR105-TAIL-01 — Dimetrodon / Tail Sweep.
Tactics names Tail Sweep and preparation names bludgeoning, but no Tail Sweep action statistics are printed. Preserve the existing Sail-Back Bite and all source text.
NEW: a physical natural melee attack, reach5ft, one perceived legal creature, +4 to hit,1d6+2 bludgeoning. Critical damage is2d6+2. One real Action; no Multiattack, Bonus Action, recharge or helper-triggered Reaction is granted. Attack magnitude uses this creature's own printed Bite benchmark; the following control is expressly NEW.
On a hit, apply damage first. If the same recipient remains a creature eligible for Prone, it then makes one DEX save against this profile's printed save-DC benchmark13. Failure applies actual Prone; success adds no Prone but does not refund the hit's damage. A miss causes neither damage nor the rider save. Actual Prone immunity prevents the rider, not the bludgeoning packet. An already-Prone recipient is not given a stacking penalty, new duration or stand-cost increase.
No area or automatic push is inferred from 'Sweep'. Prone lasts until a lawful stand or real removal; standing requires nonzero current Speed and floor(half current Speed) movement, with actual remaining budget. It survives the Dimetrodon's later source removal because posture already changed. Flying/support consequences use actual Falling rules, not free impact damage.
For comparing the original action, Sail-Back Bite stays+4,1d6+2 piercing and is completed as physical5ft one-target melee with no new rider. Same damage budget does not establish balance equivalence; Tail's new posture utility is a proposed tactical benefit pending independent review.
Reconciliation BFR105-D03 selects DEX DC13, not STR DC13. Actual saving-throw proficiency applies only if independently supplied; the profile's Save DC is not a proficiency grant.

BFR105-CONSTRICT-01 — Giant Constrictor Snake / Constrict.
Tactics names Constrict and preparation names bludgeoning, but the only printed damage action is Bite+3,1d6+1 piercing. Keep that Bite, Huge size,18HP,AC11,CR1/4 and all other printed values exact.
NEW: a physical natural melee Constrict, reach5ft, one perceived legal creature no more than one size category larger than the snake and with actual space for its body-contact coil. No tail-only remote grab is invented. Attack+3; hit1d6+1 bludgeoning, critical2d6+1. One real Action. This uses the printed Bite magnitude as the explicit numeric benchmark, not a foreign constrictor profile.
After hit damage/life processing, a still-eligible recipient makes STR DC14, using the profile's printed save-DC benchmark. Failure creates one source-qualified Grappled relationship to this snake with5ft maintained reach. Success prevents the relationship, not damage. Grappled immunity blocks only the rider. A miss supplies neither damage nor that save.
This NEW natural coil occupies one designated coiling appendage and can hold only one recipient at a time. It is not a hand-based ordinary opposed grapple. While occupied, Constrict may attack that same recipient again for its normal paid attack/damage, but does not reroll admission, refresh or duplicate the existing grapple. A different recipient requires the old grip to end first. Existing Bite can still be used at a lawful opportunity without automatically ending the hold.
Escape costs the recipient one Action and a STR(Athletics) or DEX(Acrobatics) fixed-DC14 task check; use only actual applicable proficiency. The two upper task degrees end this one relationship; other results retain it, without an invented injury. Release is free on the snake's own turn. The relationship also ends on snake Incapacitated/death/removal, target death/removal, or actual reach breaking, including forced movement/teleport; current target Speed returns to whatever its other real sources permit.
No Restrained, paralysis, suffocation, swallowed state, recurring free damage, concentration or extra action is added. A squeeze on a later turn remains a paid Constrict attack. Maintaining Grappled does not itself take away the target's Action or Reaction.
For the original Bite demonstration, its unchanged+3 and1d6+1 piercing use physical5ft one-target melee. Reason/tradeoff: this selects finite damage plus escapable movement control while retaining the unusually low printed CR/HP and explicit attack modifier; the record is not re-rated to satisfy a spell test.
Reconciliation BFR105-D04/D05: escape is a fixed-DC TASK, never a STR/DEX saving throw. Apply Core task degrees and natural1/20 degree shifts; collapse Success/Critical Success to ending this relationship and Failure/Critical Failure to retaining it. No extra escape effect or injury is implied by a degree. Actual Athletics/Acrobatics proficiency and check-only modifiers/Help require their own real source and still apply; saving-throw proficiency never supplies them. The initial post-hit STR DC14 is still a binary SAVE and is not converted into a task. The maximum target size is one actual category above this printed Huge source: Gargantuan is eligible by SIZE, not automatically by all requirements. A usable single coiling appendage must be able to obtain real accessible body-contact within5ft along a clear contact path while both occupied bodies remain legally placed. Whole-body encirclement is not a new prerequisite, but neither a size label nor minimum distance alone manufactures coil contact, appendage availability, anatomy or movement. With the coil occupied, a different-target Constrict attempt is rejected before spending another Action unless the old grip is actually released first. An ordinary paid same-target Constrict can deal its printed completed damage again without a second admission save or resetting the relationship. A later acquired size change needs its actual source; no such effect or Gargantuan stat block is granted here.

15.defenseProcedure: Use exact printed typed defenses; disease label is prevention of actual disease acquisition/progression only, not a damage type, Poison immunity or resistance to every associated attack. A save is binary meeting DC; natural20 is not automatic save success. Use actual typed defenses and temporary HP, then actual normal-HP loss and overkill. CORE ordering: lethal instant-death threshold precedes a living recipient's Wound check; otherwise one qualifying Wound check occurs on positive-to-zero or post-temp damage at least half effective maximum. DC=max(10,floor(post-temp/2)); subtract pre-event Wounds from the CON save. Failure adds one Wound; a fourth Wound kills. Failure by at least5 also uses the actual d6 injury result. Do not reduce maximum HP merely because a Wound was added: Critical's ordinary-heal ceiling is not a maximum-HP clamp. Ordinary monsters reaching zero die/end after their actual life sequence unless a real valid knockout or source override applies. Significant-NPC death-save handling must be declared before the event. Death is distinct from zero, suppression, disappearance, and harvest availability. Each attack names the creature as dealer; controller Null does not transfer to it. Ordinary living profiles use Stable0 and the one actual Stable clock. Printed Constructs are explicitly nonliving Constructs and use accepted Null Disabled0 without creating salvage. NEW for only the four printed Undead here: ordinary damage at zero destroys the same body into its finite native remains; a qualifying Null root instead leaves the same nonliving body Null Disabled0, no corpse/soul/loot. This is not the named Silence Wraith projection rule, a resurrection, generic repair or a global Undead physiology. Only a real compatible recovery source restores a disabled nonliving body. Roots, life events and finite-remains claims are durable and idempotent. Existing Core detail: each Wound penalizes CON saves and normal Hit-Dice recovery maximum by1 only; at3Wounds Critical gives Speed-10ft and ordinary-heal ceiling max(1,effectiveMaximum-1), not maximum-HP loss. A focused identification attempt uses one real Search/Research Action in combat with actual observable signs or examined remains, or one uninterrupted minute of ordinary examination outside combat. tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Sail-Back Bite** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Tail Sweep** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. It attacks from concealment, protects its escape path, and stops pursuing once territory or food is secured.
tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for piercing, bludgeoning damage.
- Carry bait, scent control, and a noncombat retreat route.

**Combat Priority**

Control its escape and feeding choices rather than cornering it.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **None identified**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when the creature reaches favorable terrain or isolates a target. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.
tactics.originalHabitat:
Predators choose terrain that hides approach and protects retreat. The lair is usually more dangerous than the animal.

Not every dangerous creature serves a faction or cosmic principle. Ordinary predators become expedition-level threats when dungeon terrain, repeated Openings, or magical food chains reshape them.

Animal Handling, food, territory, and nonthreatening movement matter more than language.
tactics.procedure: At each actual regular START choose from the creature's real perceptions, remembered observations and declared objective: an actual legal source-specific objective/counter first; otherwise the printed How It Fights opening attack, a ready announced area only if its visible recipients suit the objective, then a legal native sequence. A failed path or unavailable target does not grant hidden location knowledge or teleportation. A territorial withdrawal decision and an intelligent surrender/parley are choices, not conditions that remove a player's agency. To disengage under threat the creature must spend its own actual Withdraw/Disengage Action and actual movement, or bear ordinary opportunity-attack risk; no guaranteed escape or unearned pursuit distance. tactics.originalHowItFights: It opens with **Sentinel Halberd** against the target most capable of controlling its movement. It uses **Pressure Wave** to punish anyone who tries to stabilize that target. When **Containment Pulse** recharges, it delays only if it can catch a more important cluster or interrupt a decisive ritual. tactics.originalHowToDefeat:
**Prepare Before Contact**

- Prepare resistance or mitigation for slashing, force damage.
- Spread before **Containment Pulse** becomes available.
- Bring forced movement and terrain creation.

**Combat Priority**

Split the formation and destroy the coordinating body.

**Exploit**

The defining weakness is **forced movement that breaks formation**. Treat this as an encounter solution rather than an automatic damage vulnerability. Successful Research, Recon, or Resource actions should make the exploit easier or safer.

**Withdraw When**

Withdraw or change the objective when Containment Pulse catches three or more Expedition members. A failed retreat against this creature usually costs more than abandoning the immediate treasure.

Drone zones favor grids, choke points, rotating doors, magnetic floors, and lines that improve formation attacks. Their positions are part of the stat block.

Order-Drones are collective constructs designed to solve movement, trespass, and containment problems through formation. A “pair,” “tetrad,” or “quintet” is one tactical intelligence distributed across several bodies.

Correct credentials, maintenance codes, or a higher-priority emergency may redirect them. Emotional appeals do nothing unless the automaton was built to interpret them.
